journal.reimagined.page.seasons:
SEASONS

A year lasts 96 days: four seasons of 24 days.

Use /reimagined calendar to check the date. Seasonal crop growth depends on the local biome.
journal.reimagined.page.skills:
SKILLS

Actions train ten skill trees. Levels continue indefinitely, but each tree has only three upgrade ranks.

/reimagined skills
/reimagined skills unlock <tree>
journal.reimagined.page.recipes:
RECIPES

Ordinary crafting and furnace processes: Minecraft recipe book.

Machine instructions: journal chapters.

Mod items: Reimagined creative tabs.
journal.reimagined.page.engineering:
ENGINEERING

Flowing water turns a water wheel. Connect its axis to shafts and a millstone.

Wheels supply 16 load; mills use 8. Overload stops rotation. Hoppers automate milling.
journal.reimagined.page.magic:
MAGIC

Basic spells stay available. Create altar focuses, then table folios. Record 2 biomes / 1 creature first. Read a folio to learn. Sneak-use a wand to select. Rituals need amethyst.
journal.reimagined.page.combat:
COMBAT

Left click attacks normally. Sneak + right click uses a weapon special. Specials share a cooldown and cost durability.

Raise a shield just before a melee hit to parry.
journal.reimagined.page.undiscovered: No observations yet. Explore nearby terrain and look for living creatures.
journal.reimagined.page.wildlife:
FOREST DEER

Look in forests, taigas and meadows. Deer follow sweet berries. Feed two adults berries to breed a fawn.

Keep wolves away: deer flee from them.

journal.reimagined.page.cooking:
COOKING

Heat a pot with campfire or magma. A hopper may sit between them. Add ingredients and bowls. Barley + apple: porridge. Flour + both mushrooms: dumplings. Eating returns the bowl.

reimagined.forge.guide: Forge iron equipment once: metal + leather/flint + coal, reusable iron hammer. Bellows and Smith rank 2 raise quality. See recipes.
reimagined.forge.slot.0: Unworked iron equipment. One-time treatment; names/enchantments/wear are retained.
reimagined.forge.slot.1: Metal: iron or steel ingot, as required by the recipe.
reimagined.forge.slot.2: Treatment: flint for a keen edge, leather for extra durability.
reimagined.forge.slot.3: Fuel: one coal/charcoal per completed operation. No idle burning.
reimagined.forge.slot.4: Reusable iron hammer. Loses 4 durability per operation; Unbreaking works normally.
reimagined.forge.slot.5: Optional bellows. With Smith rank 2+, raise quality by 1(max 3). Not consumed.
reimagined.forge.slot.6: Finished equipment. Repair it in the left anvil slot to retain its finish.
reimagined.forge.recipe_note: Base quality %s. Smith rank 2 + installed bellows: +1(max 3). Hammer is reused (4 wear); coal is consumed. Output shown at base quality; actual components/wear are retained. Cannot repeat treatment.
journal.reimagined.page.orchard:
ORCHARD

Pear trees grow in forests and meadows. Graft a pear with an oak sapling for more.

Fruit ripens in summer and autumn; right-click leaves to harvest. Pear logs make planks.
tooltip.reimagined.bee_frame: Right-click a hive or nest to install up to 3. Each frame adds honeycomb.
tooltip.reimagined.bee_smoker: Use on a full hive to harvest safely; use in air to calm angry bees.
message.reimagined.bee_frames_full: This hive already holds three frames.
journal.reimagined.page.beekeeping:
BEEKEEPING

Hives and nests fill with honey; harvest with bottles or a smoker.

Frames add honeycomb. Mill honeycomb into wax.

quest.reimagined.chapter_1.title: First Steps
quest.reimagined.chapter_1.description: Learn the basics of survival: gather resources, craft tools, build shelter, find food, understand seasons, explore caves, meet villagers, and choose your path.
quest.reimagined.chapter_1.message: Your journey begins here. Follow the quests step by step.
quest.reimagined.ch1.awakening.title: Awakening
quest.reimagined.ch1.awakening.descripti: Gather wood and stone, then craft a crafting table. This is your first step into the world.
quest.reimagined.ch1.awakening.subtitle: Gather wood, craft a crafting table
quest.reimagined.ch1.first_tools.title: First Tools
quest.reimagined.ch1.first_tools.descrip: Craft a wooden pickaxe and axe. Tools let you gather resources faster.
quest.reimagined.ch1.shelter.title: Shelter
quest.reimagined.ch1.shelter.description: Build a basic shelter with a crafting table and a bed. Sleep through your first night.
quest.reimagined.ch1.shelter.subtitle: Build shelter with bed and crafting table
quest.reimagined.ch1.food_and_nature.des: Find food, cook it, and learn about animals and plants. Wheat can be grown for bread.
quest.reimagined.ch1.food_and_nature.sub: Find and cook food, find wheat
quest.reimagined.ch1.season_change.title: Season Change
quest.reimagined.ch1.season_change.descr: Open your Research Journal and check the current season. Seasons affect crop growth.
quest.reimagined.ch1.underground.title: Underground
quest.reimagined.ch1.underground.descrip: Descend into a cave. Collect cobblestone and find iron ore. Bring torches.
quest.reimagined.ch1.first_contact.title: First Contact
quest.reimagined.ch1.first_contact.descr: Find a village and trade with a villager. Villagers offer useful items for emeralds.
quest.reimagined.ch1.choose_direction.de: You have learned the basics. Choose your path: technology, magic, or both. A compass will help you navigate.
